about: Every value below is an ESTIMATE by the owner, not a reported number. 'basis' says what it is anchored on. Shared macro drivers (rates, inflation, GDP, CRR, minimum CAR) are read from sector/macro-assumptions/macro.csv by scenario name.

anchor.fy2026e_method: FY2026E = 9M-2026 actual x 12/9 for every income and expense line, then tax at the assumed rate. Balance sheet = 30 Sep 2026 actual carried to 31 Dec 2026, except equity (adds Q4 profit) and the liquid-asset plug. Dividends = 604.370m actually paid in 9M-2026.
anchor.same_for_all_scenarios: FY2026E is identical in all three scenarios because three quarters are reported.

loan_yield_spread_over_tbill_364d_pct.basis: Chosen so that, with the liquid spread below, the forward formula reproduces 9M-2026 annualised interest income within about 2 percent (see the calibration line in checks.md). Sector average lending rate was 15.8% in Oct 2026 vs a 2026 average 364-day bill of about 11%.

liquid_yield_spread_over_tbill_364d_pct.basis: Earning liquid assets are cash and securities less the reserve held at the central bank. The bank's liquid book earned about 11.2% in 2026 on that base, close to the 364-day bill average of 11.0%.

cost_of_deposits_to_policy_rate.basis: 9M-2026 interest expense annualised (573.3m) over average customer deposits (20,273m) = 2.83%, which is 0.195 of the average policy rate of about 14.5% (18% at Dec 2025 and 11% after the Nov 2026 cut).

tax_rate.basis: 9M-2026 total tax 484.6m / profit before tax 1,384.7m = 35.0%; FY2025 35.3%; FY2024 36.5%. Includes levies as printed.

customer_deposit_growth.formula: (1+real GDP growth)*(1+CPI inflation)-1+spread, with GDP and inflation read from the macro row of the same scenario and year
customer_deposit_growth.basis: Deposits grew 41.7% in FY2025 and 24.6% in 9M-2026, well above nominal GDP, so a positive share-gain spread fades toward zero. The downside assumes growth only at nominal GDP.

net_loan_growth.formula: explicit rate by scenario, but capped so that loans/deposits does not exceed 60 percent
net_loan_growth.basis: Net loans rose 87% in 9M-2026 (3,430m to 6,406m) from a very low base; loans/deposits was 19% at FY2025 and 28% at 9M-2026 (sector advances grew 36.7% y/y in Oct 2026). Growth fades as the ratio rebuilds. The cap is a judgement; the bank's loans/deposits was 44% in FY2021.

net_trading_income_growth.basis: Net trading income was 134m (FY2021), 305m (FY2022), 297m (FY2023), 282m (FY2024), 426m (FY2025) and 257m in 9M-2026 vs 299m in 9M-2025 (down 14%), so a modest decline is assumed.

fee_income_growth_over_inflation.basis: Fee income grew 28.8% in FY2025 and 17.7% in 9M-2026 vs 9M-2025.

staff_cost_growth_over_inflation.basis: Staff costs grew 30% in FY2025 and 12.6% in 9M-2026.

other_opex_growth_over_inflation.basis: Other operating expenses grew 55% in FY2025 and 11% in 9M-2026.

depreciation_growth.basis: Depreciation and amortisation jumped from 26m (9M-2025) to 63m (9M-2026); the new level is carried and then grown with inflation.

cost_of_risk_on_average_net_loans.basis: Impairment was only 15.7m in FY2025 and 6.5m in 9M-2026 on a book that has since doubled. Reported NPL ratio 3.67% (9M-2026) vs 7.13% at FY2025 (BoG basis). Base normalises to 0.8% of average loans as the new book ages.

credit.note: The 2022 to 2024 debt-exchange related losses (impairment 557m in FY2022; modification loss on investment securities 410m in FY2023 and 343m in FY2024) are not assumed to recur.

dividend_payout_of_prior_year_profit.basis: 2026 payment of 604.4m was 60% of FY2025 profit; FY2025 payment of 464.8m was 62% of FY2024; FY2024 payment of 312.8m was 43% of FY2023. Dividends are also limited so that the capital proxy stays above the minimum plus a 5-point buffer.

capital_buffer_over_minimum_pp.basis: A management buffer above the shared minimum capital ratio; not an official target.

operating_cash_to_customer_deposits.basis: 9M-2026 cash and balances 11,747m = 52.2% of customer deposits; less the 20% reserve requirement leaves 32.2%. The reserve is applied to ALL customer deposits (a simplification).

risk_weight_on_other_assets.basis: Calibrated so the capital proxy equals the reported 24.08% at 30 Sep 2026: book equity 3,336.9 / 0.2408 = 13,858 of risk-weighted assets; less loans 6,406 leaves 7,451 over other assets of 19,566. Out-of-sample check: the same weights give 29.8% at FY2025 against 32.70% reported, so the proxy runs about 3 points LOW at that date.
